stem.en: Glass items are packed in bubble wrap or hay before they are sent by truck. How does this protect them?

text.en: It makes the glass items lighter.

feedback.en: The packing does not change the mass of the glass.

text.en: In a jolt, they stop over a longer time, so the force on them is smaller.

feedback.en: Right. The soft packing makes the stop take longer, so the acceleration and the force are smaller.

text.en: It removes friction between the items.

feedback.en: The packing protects by making each stop slower, not by removing friction.

explanation.en: In a jolt, the soft packing lets each item stop over a longer time. A smaller acceleration needs a smaller force, so the glass does not break.

hints.en: Think of the fielder pulling her hands back.
